output.reason: [ev-bfb9c0ed4d28] says only that the http-wasm host was upgraded to v0.6.0 so that clients (plugins) using v0.4.0 are supported. Treating this as a product-relationship with http-wasm fits the text. However, the release notes never state the previous host version, so the before value "v0.5.0 or earlier" is made up. Without a stated before value, value-changed cannot be asserted. What the evidence does support is behavior-changed: the host is now v0.6.0 and plugins built against http-wasm v0.4.0 are now supported.

correction.statement: Traefik 3.0.0 upgrades its embedded http-wasm host to v0.6.0, adding support for plugins (clients) built with http-wasm v0.4.0.
